frame: x right (as you sit), y depth toward the user (0 = back edge of the base / desk), z up (0 = desk); origin back-left-bottom of the base; boxes on the nominal 8 mm grid (real parts 0.1 mm smaller/side); studs (dia 4.8, 1.7 tall) on top of every non-tile part (slopes: high row only; jumper 15573: one centre stud; curved slopes: none); 'slope' {down, high_mm, lip_mm} as in dock/bricks.json, plus curved:true (2/3-high bow, no studs) or inverted:true (the overhang points toward 'down', studs on the whole top); 'section' = base | pockets | dock | necks | frame

sections.base: hollow base: floor, outer wall, ribs, deck, deck tiles
sections.necks: two necks round the VESA poles

steps.1: Floor: Tan plates over the whole footprint (studs up), including under the dock. The two rectangular gaps at the back are for the desk clamps.
steps.2: Pocket block, lower half (the tray of the pocket-base build): plates, then bricks and plates leaving the two 13 x 13 pad cavities and their cable channels to the back.
steps.3: Hollow base: outer wall (Tan below, Sand Blue above) and the hidden ribs up to deck height; the strip behind the dock with the dock cable channel. Leave the two clamp bays open at the back.
steps.4: Not LEGO: clamp the two VIVO poles to the desk through the clamp bays; foam + Anker pads into the cavities; Plugable dock box into the right bay; run the cables.
steps.5: Charging floor: the three black 8 x 16 tiles over the pads, black tiles on the rest of the pocket floors, plates under the walls.
steps.6: Pocket walls: two brick courses, Sand Blue wherever a face shows.
steps.7: Deck plates on the walls and ribs (the three lids are separate groups), Sand Blue plate round the outside edge.
steps.8: Top tiles: Sand Blue deck and pocket rims, two Pearl Gold marks behind each pocket, the three pastel patches at the front left.
steps.9: Dock, lower part: plug seat, plug pocket and cable channel, then fit the Newnex plug exactly as in the dock build, and close the floor (roof tiles, jumpers, floor tiles).
steps.10: Dock walls: Tan outer panel on the left wall, Sand Blue elsewhere, lead-in slopes.
steps.11: Necks: two cheeks either side of each pole and the striped pedestal under the frame.
steps.12: Not LEGO: bolt the VESA plates to the monitors (stand-offs on the thinner one), hang them on the brackets, set height and level so both sit 2-3 mm above the frame's bottom beam line.
steps.13: Frame bottom beam on the two pedestals, with the first aluminium flat bar in its slot.
steps.14: Frame sides, the web between the two screens and the bezel lips (they overlap the monitors' edges by a few mm without touching).
steps.15: Top beam with the second flat bar, the retaining lips behind the monitors' top edge and the rounded corners.
steps.16: Liners and devices: felt in the dock, felt pads on the retaining lips and bezel corners, laptop, keyboard, mouse.
